lead_fa: Brewmaster تانک نرم‌سازی آسیب (Stagger) است: به‌جای جلوگیری از ضربه، آن را پخش و قابل مدیریت می‌کند و با Purifying Brew دفع می‌کند. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Shado-Pan]] با Flurry Strike های خودکار و [[Master of Harmony]] با Celestial Brew/Infusion و دفاع قابل تنظیم‌تر.

strengths: Durability: Stagger, Shuffle, and Celestial Fortune make Brewmasters great at surviving all kinds of damage
Mobility: Roll, Tiger's Lust, and Transcendence combine for high mobility
Customizable defense: talents like Niuzao's Resolve or Celestial Infusion match your content
Uniqueness: only source of Mystic Touch, plus the Windwalking aura
Versatility: Paralysis CC, Detox dispel, Ring of Peace displacement, Leg Sweep AoE stun
weaknesses: Complexity: a LOT of keybinds across rotational abilities, cooldowns, and utility
Small health pool among tanks: more vulnerable to sustained spell damage and DoTs
Heavy punishments for mistakes; playstyle can be unintuitive

hero.recommendation: Both trees are largely passive; the decision-making between damage and defense sets them apart.
hero.shado_pan: Flurry Strikes trigger automatically as you cast Keg Smash during the basic rotation.
hero.master_of_harmony: Occasionally press Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion to spend built-up vitality; offers extra effects on the main Brewmaster defensives.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Brewmaster Monk Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/monk/brewmaster/talent-builds-pve-tank), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Stagger is your core mitigation: purify with Purifying Brew at the right moments rather than spamming it.
Blackout Kick triggers Blackout Combo; spend the buff with Tiger Palm or other abilities.
Keg Smash is both damage and Purifying Brew cooldown reduction; keep its charges rolling.

st: Execute an enemy with Touch of Death when allowed
Blackout Kick to trigger Blackout Combo
Consume one charge of Celestial Brew/Celestial Infusion only for extra damage if at two charges
Activate Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox
Consume your Blackout Combo buff with Tiger Palm
Consume an active Empty Barrel from Bring Me Another
Use a charge of Keg Smash
If taking minimal damage, use an extra Purifying Brew charge to trigger Special Delivery or Empty Barrels
Tiger Palm when there are no other abilities to press
rotation.aoe_note: The AoE priority mirrors single target: with two Keg Smash charges, spend the first charge (or an Empty Barrel) before Exploding Keg and the second charge after; Breath of Fire stays high in the list for pack damage.
rotation.stagger_primer: Stagger splits incoming physical damage into an instant portion and a DoT portion you can purify; Shuffle (Blackout Kick) reduces the staggered portion. Purify when the staggered damage is approaching dangerous thresholds, not on cooldown.

gear.gearing_rules: Item level (Agility) beats secondary optimization; at equal ilvl use Critical Strike = Versatility = Mastery > Haste (defense-first). Prioritize a high-ilvl weapon, then tier set and desired trinkets; craft fillers without embellishments if needed. Sim for damage.

mplus.hero_note: Shado-Pan carries the Best tag for Mythic+; its automatic Flurry Strikes suit pack-to-pack pacing.
tips: Leg Sweep and Ring of Peace are premium pull control; Paralysis covers dangerous casters.
Purifying Brew discipline matters most in M+: keep Stagger from turning Yellow/Red during big pulls.
Transcendence ports solve many dungeon mechanics without movement.
